name: WPGenie Save & Clear Cart for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Save & Clear Cart for WooCommerce empowers shoppers to manage their carts effortlessly. Whether customers want to empty their cart with a single click or save their current selections for later, this plugin delivers a smooth, frictionless shopping experience.

Both registered customers and guest shoppers can save multiple named carts, review saved items, and restore them anytime with the choice to either replace the active cart or merge items into their current selection.

Key Features

  • One-Click Clear Cart: Add an intuitive “Clear Cart” button to the WooCommerce cart page with an accessible confirmation dialog to prevent accidental clicks.
  • Save Multiple Carts: Customers and guests can save named carts with all item details, quantities, and attributes.
  • Smart Cart Restoration: Restore saved carts seamlessly. Configure the store to ask shoppers (Replace or Merge), always replace existing items, or always merge saved items into current cart contents.
  • Guest User Support: Guest shoppers can save carts during their browsing session. Saved guest carts are automatically migrated to their account once they log in or register.
  • WooCommerce My Account Integration: Adds a dedicated “Saved Carts” endpoint to the customer’s My Account navigation.
  • Shortcode Support: Place the action buttons or the saved carts table on custom pages using clean shortcodes:
    • [wpgenie_save_clear_cart_buttons] – Outputs the Clear Cart and Save Cart buttons anywhere.
    • [wpgenie_saved_carts] – Displays the user’s saved carts management table anywhere.
  • Full Design Customization: Match your store branding through WooCommerce Settings. Customize button labels, background colors, text colors, and border colors.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built with performant code, lightweight styling, and native JavaScript for minimal footprint and instant response.
  • Modern Block Themes & FSE Ready: Seamlessly compatible with modern block themes (Full Site Editing / FSE) such as Twenty Twenty-Four and Twenty Twenty-Five, WooCommerce Cart Blocks, as well as all classic themes.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Save & Clear Cart for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. In your WordPress Dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin after installation.

Configuration

  1. In your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to WooCommerce > Settings.
  2. Click the Save & Clear Cart tab.
  3. Configure your button text, colors, and cart restoration preferences.
  4. Click Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work for guest users?

Yes. Guest users can save and restore carts during their session. When a guest registers or logs in, their saved carts are automatically linked and migrated to their user account.

Can customers save more than one cart?

Yes. Customers can create and name multiple carts (e.g., “Monthly Supplies”, “Office Hardware”, “Birthday Gifts”) and manage them independently.

What is the difference between Replace and Merge when restoring a cart?

  • Replace: Empties the current cart before loading the saved cart items.
  • Merge: Keeps the items currently in the cart and adds the saved items to them, combining quantities if an item is already present.
    Store administrators can set a default mode or let the customer choose via a modal prompt.

Where do customers see their saved carts?

Registered customers can see and manage their saved carts directly in My Account > Saved Carts, as well as beneath the cart table on the Cart page. You can also place the saved carts table on any page using the [wpgenie_saved_carts] shortcode.

Can I customize the button colors to match my theme?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Save & Clear Cart to change the background, text, and border colors for both the “Clear Cart” and “Save Cart” buttons without writing any custom CSS.

Does this plugin work with new block themes and Full Site Editing (FSE)?

Yes. It is fully compatible with modern WordPress block themes (such as Twenty Twenty-Four, Twenty Twenty-Five, and other FSE themes), the WooCommerce Cart Block, and all standard classic WooCommerce themes.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin is fully tested and declares full compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (custom order tables).
